resources.string: Choose a saved SSH or Telnet host, then open the remote terminal. SSH uses transient credentials; Telnet login is typed in the unencrypted terminal. Closing or hiding this window ends the session and renderer; commands and input are never replayed.
Choose a saved SSH or Telnet host.
Enter credentials for this host. The current trusted key is checked before authentication.
Disconnecting. Waiting for the terminal and transport owners to retire…
Permission request finished. Use Open terminal explicitly to connect.
No SSH or Telnet hosts are saved. Add one from the workspace home first.
Telnet host selected. Login is typed at the remote prompt; this connection is unencrypted.
Connected over unencrypted Telnet. Starting the terminal…
Telnet sends login credentials and session data in clear text. Use it only on a trusted network. Cloudy does not store Telnet credentials; type them at the remote prompt.
Shell open. Input is sent only to this connection.
Local network access is required for this host.
This local terminal panel could not take keyboard focus. Close it and try again.
Remote mouse reporting is active. Shift+right-click opens the local menu.
The terminal is not ready for that local action.
The saved right-click choice is not confirmed yet. Choose an action from this menu.
There is no terminal selection to copy.
The selection exceeds 60 KiB and was not copied.
The selection is not valid Unicode and was not copied.
The clipboard could not be updated. Nothing was copied.
The clipboard has no plain text. Nothing was pasted.
The clipboard item is not supported plain text. Nothing was pasted.
The clipboard text exceeds 60 KiB. Nothing was pasted.
The clipboard text is not valid Unicode. Nothing was pasted.
The clipboard is unavailable. Nothing was pasted.
This text contains line breaks or control characters. In an unbracketed shell, line breaks can execute commands. Insert only if you trust the content.
